email.subject: Riverside Manufacturing Co. Renewal Request — Policy SBA-4471902
email.body:
Good morning,

We are reaching out regarding the upcoming renewal for Riverside Manufacturing Co., policy SBA-4471902, which is scheduled to expire on 01/01/2027. Please prepare the renewal quotation and confirm terms for an effective date of 01/01/2027.

Riverside Manufacturing Co. operates a sheet-metal fabrication and industrial machining facility at 2200 Foundry Road, Cleveland, OH 44115. Karen Delgado is our contact for all renewal correspondence.

Thank you,
Great Lakes Insurance Advisors

Correction: the total premium should read slightly lower than the attached invoice; we're reconciling.

Karen Delgado
Riverside Manufacturing Co.

CONFIDENTIALITY NOTICE: This message and any attachments are intended solely for the addressee and may contain confidential information.
